tenses.meaning: Привычки, факты и расписания: то, что происходит регулярно или всегда верно.
formula: −  I don't work · he doesn't work
?  Do you work? · Does she work?

uses.en: I drink coffee every morning.
uses.ru: Я пью кофе каждое утро.

uses.en: Water boils at 100 degrees.
uses.ru: Вода кипит при 100 градусах.

uses.en: The train leaves at 7:30.
uses.ru: Поезд отправляется в 7:30.

traps.bad: She work here.
traps.note: С he / she / it глагол получает -s.

traps.bad: Does she works?
traps.note: После does / do глагол без -s.

ex.q: My sister ___ (work) in a bank. It's her job.
ex.w: Постоянное занятие; с she глагол получает -s.

ex.q: I ___ (not like) spicy food, so I never order it.
___ she speak French at work?
ex.w: Вопрос про she: Does + глагол без -s.

ex.q: The sun always ___ (rise) in the east.
My train ___ (leave) at 8:15 tomorrow.
They usually ___ (go) to bed at eleven.
He ___ (not/watch) TV in the morning; it's his routine.
Water always ___ (freeze) at 0 degrees Celsius.
Tom always ___ (carry) an umbrella.
She ___ (study) English every evening; it's her routine.

tenses.meaning: То, что происходит прямо сейчас или в этот период, и договорённости на ближайшее будущее.
formula: +  I am working · she is working

uses.en: Look! It is raining.
uses.ru: Смотри! Идёт дождь.

uses.en: I'm staying with friends this week.
uses.ru: На этой неделе я живу у друзей.

uses.en: We are meeting Anna at 6 tonight.
uses.ru: Мы встречаемся с Анной сегодня в 6.

traps.bad: I am knowing him.
traps.note: Глаголы состояния (know, like, want, understand) не ставят в -ing.

traps.bad: She working now.
traps.note: Не забывайте am / is / are.

ex.q: Look! It ___ (rain).
Be quiet! The baby ___ (sleep).
I ___ (not/work) right now. I'm on a break.
ex.w: Сейчас, в этот период: am not + глагол-ing.

ex.q: ___ she watching TV right now?
We ___ (meet) Tom at 6 tonight; we've already agreed.
He ___ (stay) at a hotel at the moment.
ex.w: at the moment — временная ситуация сейчас.

ex.q: The children ___ (play) in the garden at the moment.
Listen! Someone ___ (knock) at the door.
ex.w: Listen! — идёт прямо сейчас; someone → is.

ex.q: I ___ (learn) to drive these days.
ex.w: these days — период, который идёт сейчас.

ex.q: She ___ (not/listen) to me right now.

tenses.meaning: Связь прошлого с настоящим: важен результат сейчас, время действия не названо.
formula: +  I have worked · she has worked

uses.en: I have lost my keys.
uses.ru: Я потерял ключи (их нет и сейчас).

uses.en: Have you ever been to London?
uses.ru: Ты когда-нибудь бывал в Лондоне?

uses.t: for и since: началось раньше и длится до сих пор
uses.en: She has lived here since 2015.
uses.ru: Она живёт здесь с 2015 года.

traps.bad: I have seen him yesterday.
traps.note: С точным временем в прошлом (yesterday, last week) — Past Simple.

traps.bad: She has gone to Rome — she's back.
traps.note: been — съездил и вернулся, gone — уехал и ещё там.

ex.q: I ___ (lose) my keys. I still can't open the door.
ex.w: Результат важен сейчас: have + третья форма.

ex.q: She ___ (live) here since 2015.
___ you ever been to Spain?
ex.w: ever + опыт: Have you ever been…?

ex.q: We ___ (not/finish) the project yet.
He ___ (just/arrive).
I ___ (know) Mark for ten years, and we are still friends.
ex.w: for ten years, и дружба продолжается → have known.

ex.q: They ___ (visit) Paris three times so far.
ex.w: so far — опыт до настоящего момента; они → have.

ex.q: It's the first time I ___ (eat) sushi.
ex.w: It's the first time… → Present Perfect.

ex.q: She ___ (already/buy) the tickets.
I ___ (be) to Rome twice.

tenses.meaning: Действие началось раньше и идёт до сих пор или только что закончилось; важна длительность.
formula: +  I have been working · she has been working

uses.en: I have been waiting for an hour.
uses.ru: Я жду уже час.

uses.en: You're wet. Have you been running?
uses.ru: Ты мокрый. Ты бегал?

uses.en: She has been writing a book all year.
uses.ru: Она весь год пишет книгу.

traps.bad: I've been knowing him for years.
traps.note: Глаголы состояния (know, have, like) не ставят в -ing.

traps.bad: I'm waiting for you for an hour.
traps.good: I've been waiting for you for an hour.
traps.note: Про действие, которое длится до сих пор (for / since), Present Continuous не подходит.

ex.q: You're finally here! I ___ (wait) for you since five o'clock.
ex.w: since five o'clock — и я ждал до сих пор.

ex.q: She ___ (study) since morning.
ex.w: since morning — длится до сих пор.

ex.q: How long ___ you been learning English?
Her eyes are red. She ___ (cry).
It ___ (rain) all day, and the streets are still wet.
ex.w: all day — длительность до сих пор.

ex.q: We ___ (not/sleep) well lately.
He ___ (work) here since 2019.
I ___ (try) to call you since 9 a.m.
ex.w: since 9 a.m. — длится до сих пор.

ex.q: They ___ (build) the house for six months.
ex.w: for six months — длится до сих пор.

ex.q: You look tired. ___ you been working too hard?

tenses.meaning: Законченное действие в прошлом, обычно с указанием времени.

uses.en: I visited Rome last year.
uses.ru: Я был в Риме в прошлом году.

uses.en: She came in, sat down and smiled.
uses.ru: Она вошла, села и улыбнулась.

uses.en: We lived in Kyiv when I was a child.
uses.ru: Мы жили в Киеве, когда я был ребёнком.

traps.bad: Did you went?
traps.note: После did глагол в начальной форме.

traps.bad: I goed there.
traps.note: Неправильные глаголы: go — went, buy — bought, see — saw.

ex.q: I ___ (see) Tom yesterday.
They ___ (not/come) to the party last night.
___ you enjoy the film last night?
ex.w: Прошлое с last night: Did you + глагол?

ex.q: She ___ (buy) a new phone two days ago.
We ___ (live) in Spain when I was a child.
ex.w: when I was a child — прошлое.

ex.q: He ___ (open) the window and looked outside.
When ___ you last see him?
ex.w: When + прошедшее время: did you see.

ex.q: I ___ (go) to the gym last Monday.
ex.w: last Monday — законченное время в прошлом: went.

ex.q: The film ___ (start) at eight and ended at ten.
She ___ (not/know) the answer, so she asked me.

tenses.meaning: Процесс в определённый момент прошлого или фоновое действие, которое прервали.
formula: +  I was working · we were working

uses.en: At 8 o'clock I was cooking dinner.
uses.ru: В восемь я готовил ужин.

uses.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
uses.ru: Я шёл домой, когда начался дождь.

uses.en: She was reading while he was cooking.
uses.ru: Она читала, пока он готовил.

traps.bad: She was knowing the answer.
traps.note: Глаголы состояния (know, like, want) не ставят в continuous.

traps.bad: I working at 8.
traps.note: Не забывайте was / were.

ex.q: At 9 last night I ___ (watch) TV, so I didn't hear the phone.
ex.w: Процесс в момент в прошлом: was + -ing.

ex.q: I ___ (walk) home when it started to rain.
She was cooking while he ___ (watch) TV.
What ___ you doing at 7 yesterday?
They ___ (not/sleep) when I called.
ex.w: Процесс в момент звонка; they → weren't.

ex.q: While I ___ (study), my brother was playing music.
He broke his leg while he ___ (ski).
It ___ (snow) when we left the house.
ex.w: Фон в момент, когда мы вышли.

ex.q: I ___ (not/listen) when the teacher explained it.
___ it raining when you got home?

tenses.meaning: Действие, которое завершилось раньше другого действия в прошлом.

uses.en: When I arrived, the film had already started.
uses.ru: Когда я пришёл, фильм уже начался.

uses.en: He was sad because he had lost his job.
uses.ru: Он грустил, потому что потерял работу.

uses.en: She said she had seen him before.
uses.ru: Она сказала, что видела его раньше.

traps.bad: When I came, she has left.
traps.good: When I came, she had left.
traps.note: Прошлое «до прошлого» — had + третья форма.

traps.bad: I had went there before.
traps.note: После had — третья форма глагола: gone, а не went.

ex.q: When we arrived, the film ___ (already/start).
ex.w: Фильм начался раньше, чем мы пришли.

ex.q: She was angry because he ___ (forget) her birthday.
By the time I got to the station, the train ___ (leave).
ex.w: by the time + прошлое → had + третья форма.

ex.q: I didn't have any money because I ___ (lose) my wallet.
He told me that he ___ (see) the film before.
___ you finished your homework before your mom came home?
ex.w: Had you finished…? — до другого прошлого момента.

ex.q: They ___ (not/eat) when I came, so I joined them.
ex.w: К моменту моего прихода ещё не ели.

ex.q: After she ___ (finish) work, she went home.
I realized I ___ (leave) my keys at home.
The teacher asked why we ___ (not/do) the homework.

tenses.meaning: Длительность до момента в прошлом: как долго что-то шло до другого прошлого события.

uses.en: When she called, I had been waiting for two hours.
uses.ru: Когда она позвонила, я ждал уже два часа.

uses.en: He was tired because he had been running.
uses.ru: Он устал, потому что бегал.

uses.en: They had been talking for hours before they decided.
uses.ru: Они часами говорили, прежде чем решили.

traps.bad: I had been knowing her for years.
traps.good: I had known her for years.
traps.note: Глаголы состояния (know, have) не ставят в -ing.

traps.bad: I had been wait for two hours.
traps.good: I had been waiting for two hours.
traps.note: После had been глагол с -ing.

ex.q: She was exhausted because she ___ (run) for an hour.
I ___ (wait) for two hours when the bus finally came.
ex.w: for two hours до прихода автобуса.

ex.q: They ___ (work) all night, so they were sleepy in the morning.
How long ___ you been waiting when she arrived?
He ___ (study) for hours before he took a break.
The ground was wet. It ___ (rain).
We ___ (not/talk) for long when the lights went out.
ex.w: Недолго до момента, когда погас свет.

ex.q: She ___ (cry), so her eyes were red.
I ___ (drive) for three hours when I saw the sign.
ex.w: for three hours до момента, когда увидел знак.

ex.q: By 2020 he ___ (live) in Berlin for ten years, so he decided to stay.

tenses.meaning: Решение в момент речи, предсказания, обещания; заранее принятый план — be going to.
formula: +  I will work · I'm going to work

uses.en: It's cold. I'll close the window.
uses.ru: Холодно. Я закрою окно.

uses.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
uses.ru: Думаю, завтра будет дождь.

uses.t: Заранее принятый план — конструкция be going to (отдельная от will)
uses.en: We're going to move next month.
uses.ru: Мы собираемся переехать в следующем месяце.

traps.bad: If it will rain, I'll stay home.
traps.good: If it rains, I'll stay home.
traps.note: После if и when про будущее — Present Simple.

traps.bad: I will to go.
traps.note: После will — глагол без to.

ex.q: It's hot here. OK, I ___ (open) the window.
ex.w: Решение в момент речи: will + глагол.

ex.q: I think it ___ (rain) tomorrow.
Wait here. I ___ (get) you a glass of water.
ex.w: Решение в момент речи: will + глагол.

ex.q: Your surprise party is next week. I ___ (not/tell) anyone.
Look at those clouds! It ___ (rain).
ex.w: По признакам видно: be going to.

ex.q: We ___ (move) to a new flat next month; we've signed the contract.
___ you help me with this bag, please?
She ___ (be) 30 next year.
I'm sure you ___ (pass) the exam tomorrow.
I promise I ___ (call) you tomorrow.

tenses.meaning: Процесс в определённый момент в будущем; вежливый вопрос о планах.

uses.en: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.
uses.ru: Завтра в это время я буду лететь в Рим.

uses.t: Событие, которое и так произойдёт по плану
uses.en: I'll be seeing Anna later. Shall I tell her?
uses.ru: Я увижусь с Анной позже. Ей что-нибудь передать?

uses.en: Will you be using the car tonight?
uses.ru: Вы будете пользоваться машиной сегодня вечером?

traps.bad: I will working at 8.
traps.note: Нужны все части: will be + -ing.

traps.bad: I will be knowing the results tomorrow.
traps.good: I will know the results tomorrow.
traps.note: Глаголы состояния (know, want, like) не ставят в continuous.

ex.q: This time tomorrow I ___ (lie) on a beach.
ex.w: This time tomorrow — процесс в будущем.

ex.q: At 8 tonight she ___ (watch) her favorite show.
ex.w: В конкретное время будущего — будет идти процесс.

ex.q: Don't call at 9. We ___ (have) dinner.
___ you be using the laptop this evening?
Next Friday at 10 a.m. I ___ (take) my exam.
She ___ (not/sleep) at midnight; she works nights.
ex.w: Не будет спать в этот момент.

ex.q: This time next week we ___ (fly) over the ocean.
Tomorrow at noon the kids ___ (play) in the park.
I ___ (wait) for you at the entrance at six.
Don't phone at 7. I ___ (cook).

tenses.meaning: Действие закончится к определённому моменту в будущем.

uses.t: К сроку в будущем уже закончено
uses.en: By Friday I will have finished the report.
uses.ru: К пятнице я закончу отчёт.

uses.en: It's 9 pm. She will have arrived home by now.
uses.ru: 9 вечера. Она, наверное, уже добралась домой.

uses.en: By 2030 they will have built a new bridge.
uses.ru: К 2030 году они построят новый мост.

traps.bad: By the time you will arrive, I will have left.
traps.good: By the time you arrive, I will have left.
traps.note: После by the time — Present Simple.

traps.bad: I will have finish the report by Friday.
traps.good: I will have finished the report by Friday.
traps.note: После will have — третья форма глагола.

ex.q: By the time you get home, I ___ (already/cook) dinner.
By 2030 they ___ (build) a new bridge.
She ___ (graduate) by next June.
___ you have finished the exam by 11?
I ___ (not/finish) before six tonight, so don't wait for me.
By next month, we ___ (live) here for ten years.
ex.w: by next month + for ten years.

ex.q: By the time he arrives, the meeting ___ (end).
They ___ (not/receive) the package by tomorrow.
ex.w: К завтрашнему дню ещё не получат.

ex.q: How many pages ___ you have written by then?
By the end of next year, I ___ (save) enough money to buy a car.

tenses.meaning: Длительность к моменту в будущем: сколько времени действие уже будет идти. Время редкое: в речи его часто заменяют на Future Perfect.

uses.en: By June I will have been working here for five years.
uses.ru: К июню я буду работать здесь уже пять лет.

uses.en: Next week they will have been dating for a year.
uses.ru: На следующей неделе у них будет год отношений.

uses.en: She will be tired: she will have been driving all day.
uses.ru: Она будет уставшей: она будет за рулём уже целый день.

traps.bad: I will have been know him for years.
traps.good: I will have known him for years.
traps.note: Глаголы состояния не ставят в -ing.

traps.bad: By June I work here for five years.
traps.good: By June I will have been working here for five years.
traps.note: Для длительности к сроку нужны все части: will have been + -ing.

ex.q: By June I ___ (work) here for five years.
ex.w: by June + for five years — длительность к сроку.

ex.q: By next month, we ___ (live) in this city for a decade.
By the time she arrives, I ___ (wait) for three hours.
ex.w: К её приходу — уже три часа жду.

ex.q: How long ___ you have been studying by next May?
ex.w: How long will you have been…?

ex.q: By 6 pm he ___ (drive) for ten hours.
She ___ (not/work) here for long by January.
ex.w: К январю ещё недолго будет работать.

ex.q: By next week they ___ (date) for a year.
ex.w: by next week + for a year.

ex.q: In July, I ___ (teach) for twenty years.
By the end of the day, the children ___ (play) for six hours.
ex.w: К концу дня — шесть часов игры.

ex.q: ___ it have been raining for a week by Sunday?
